dataset: Relief de la Wallonie - Modèle Numérique de Terrain (MNT) 2021–2022, updated 2024-01-23
attribution: Service public de Wallonie (SPW) - Relief de la Wallonie - MNT 2021–2022 (2024-01-23). Modified by coordinate sampling, relative datum removal and periodic interpolation.
raw_sampling: 1024 samples of the retained native centreline, approximately every 6.84 m. Invert the retained local origin and uniform scale, then transform WGS84 to EPSG:3812. ArcGIS identify esriGeometryMultipoint returns numeric Stretch.Pixel Value, not display RGB. All 1024 echoed coordinates match within 0.001 m; no missing or nonfinite heights.
vertical_datum: Metres above the minimum retained ground sample; no range scaling or artificial start/finish flattening.
interpolation: Periodic monotone cubic Hermite through every measured sample, with weighted harmonic tangents and a shared seam tangent. Dense 4 m controls plus all raw sample stations retain extrema and avoid overshoot. No low-pass filter or grade clipping.
uncertainty_note: Dataset accuracy is not road reconstruction accuracy. The OSM-derived road centreline has not been geodetically registered to the lidar; the 2 m horizontal and 0.4 m road-height allowances are conservative estimates, not measured residuals. Resurfacing since the 2021–2022 flight is not captured.
supersedes: The independently digitised 2016 Formula1 graphic retained in Git through 9392048. Its total 102.2 m relief was close, but diagram registration blunted Raidillon and raised the Blanchimont sector by about 7.5 m.
limitations: This is classified bare-earth lidar, not an as-built asphalt survey. Bridges and tunnel lids are removed from the DTM and require independent deck controls if a road query intersects them.
No apparent underpass notch or roof spike occurs in these retained racing-centreline samples. This check does not establish unmeasured road edges, crossfall or off-track terrain.
The scenery raster remains the separately retained Copernicus grid until a classified-ground scenery window is incorporated. This correction changes only the longitudinal road source.
